blockingIssues.problem: The rationale states that the committee continued the trial “because the germination results convinced it that the dry cupboard was promising.” The source does not support that causal claim or that the committee was convinced the cupboard was promising; it only records the committee chose to keep the two lots for another six months and repeat the check, and explicitly notes no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: “At its March meeting, the committee chose to keep the same two lots in the cupboard for another six months and repeat the germination check.” Also: “The notes give no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement…” and earlier: “No paired comparison of the same lot in both places was run. Neither growing-season yield nor performance in gardens was measured.”
blockingIssues.constraint: Do not present the committee as having been convinced the cupboard was promising or assert the cupboard caused improved germination. The idea must preserve the source’s uncertainty and attribution about causes and motivations and limit claims to the recorded decision to continue the trial on a limited basis.
